system.description:
Brawlers from the hill-country wrestling schools, who train with weight and fight with force rather than finesse.

  • Heavy Hands: Strength counts as one of your two key attributes (in place of Dexterity), and you may use it instead of Dexterity for Deflect Blow and Catch Weapon, and instead of Wisdom for Parrying Stance. You may also use war hammers, heavy maces, mauls, battle axes, heavy flails and halberds as monk weapons.
  • Lift and Throw: A creature you are grappling takes your primary unarmed damage at the start of each of its turns. When you throw a grappled foe, it takes your primary unarmed damage and falls prone.
